title: Pessimistic Minimax Value Iteration: Provably Efficient Equilibrium Learning from Offline Datasets
reasoning: The paper is a theoretical contribution to offline multi-agent reinforcement learning. It proposes and analyzes a new algorithm (PMVI) for finding Nash equilibria in two-player zero-sum Markov games. The content is entirely mathematical and algorithmic, with no discussion of ethics, morals, faith, or religion.
